title: Advanced RAG Capstone: Design, Implement & Evaluate
summary: Architect an end-to-end production RAG system with hybrid search, metadata ACL filtering, cross-encoder reranking, and automated RAG Triad verification.
objectives: Build a complete end-to-end RAG architecture meeting latency and groundedness SLAs.
Integrate hybrid BM25 + dense search with cross-encoder reranking.
Execute automated RAG Triad evaluation achieving >= 90% groundedness on test suites.

sections.title: Production Capstone Specification
paragraphs: In this capstone, you will build a complete enterprise RAG system that ingests heterogeneous documents, indexes them with hierarchical parent-document chunking, applies hybrid search and reranking, and validates output against strict RAG Triad thresholds.

activity.title: Deliver Production-Grade RAG Pipeline
instructions: Implement ingestion pipeline with parent-document chunking.
Deploy hybrid search and cross-encoder reranking stage.
Run evaluation suite and generate machine-readable compliance report.
evidence: Architecture diagram, pipeline implementation code, and evaluation scorecard JSON.
activity.reflectionPrompt: How does your pipeline ensure enterprise security and context boundary isolation?

questions.prompt: In a production RAG system, what is the primary purpose of separating retrieval indexing from context synthesis?
choices: To maximize semantic matching resolution while providing the LLM complete paragraph context.
To permanently delete the original source documents from enterprise storage.
To prevent models from reading system prompts.
To bypass all user authentication checks.
questions.explanation: Separating small chunk search from larger context assembly ensures high retrieval precision without sacrificing contextual coherence.
